function sectionHTML(m,s,n){let key=m.id+':'+s.page;return `<details class="section ${isCoreE(m,s)?'core-e':''}" id="s-${key.replace(':','-')}" data-search="${esc((s.title+' '+sectionBullets(m,s).join(' ')).replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''))}" ${n===0?'open':''}><summary>Section ${n+1}: ${esc(s.title)} ${priorityBadge(m,s)}</summary><div class="inner"><div class="notegrid"><div class="picturebox">${s.media?researchVisual(s):`<img class="sourcepic" loading="lazy" src="${s.image}" alt="${esc(s.title)} · ${s.reconstructed?'reconstructed study visual':'original source page '+s.page}" data-zoom="1"><div class="caption">${s.reconstructed?'Study diagram reconstructed from your supplied notes; not an original article figure.':'Original source page '+s.page+' · click to enlarge'}</div>`}</div><div class="teaching"><ul>${sectionBullets(m,s).map(b=>`<li>${b}</li>`).join('')}</ul>${m.id===2&&s.page===12?`<div class="math"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>H</mi><mo>|</mo><mi>E</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mo>|</mo><mi>H</mi><mo>)</mo><mi>Pr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>H</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>Pr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow></math></div>`:''}</div></div>${personalNotes(m,s)}<div class="sectionfoot"><label><input type="checkbox" data-read="${key}" ${state.read.includes(key)?'checked':''}> Mark read</label><button class="tiny" data-recall="${key}">Hide explanation / try recall</button>${view==='coreReview'?`<button class="tiny" data-core-expand="${m.id}:${s.page}">Expand visual + transcript</button>`:`<button class="tiny" data-teach="${m.id}:${n}">Teach this section</button>`}</div></div></details>`}
function noteTools(){return `<div class="toolbar"><input class="search" id="noteSearch" placeholder="Find a term, study, or explanation…" aria-label="Search teaching notes"><button class="tiny" data-font="-1">A−</button><button class="tiny" data-font="1">A+</button><button class="tiny" id="openAll">Expand visible sections</button><button class="tiny" id="closeAll">Collapse sections</button></div>`}
function moduleScreen(){let m=moduleBy(selected);if(mode==='expanded')return `<div class="expanded-preview">${teach(m,true)}</div>`;let count=Q.filter(q=>q.module===m.id).length;return `<span class="tag">${window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)?'MODULE 2 · SECOND HALF':'MODULE 1 · EXAM 1 ARCHIVE'}</span><h1>${esc(m.title)}</h1>${versionControl(m)}<div class="tabs" role="tablist"><button role="tab" data-mode="notes" aria-selected="${mode==='notes'}">Teaching notes</button><button role="tab" data-mode="teach" aria-selected="${mode==='teach'}">Visual + transcript</button><button role="tab" data-mode="expanded" aria-selected="${mode==='expanded'}">Expand visual + transcript</button>${count?`<button role="tab" data-mode="quiz" aria-selected="${mode==='quiz'}">Quiz · ${Math.min(window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)?window.SECOND_HALF.lectureQuizSize:30,count)}</button>`:''}</div>${window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)?'<div class="notice">Current second-half material · No short-term memory practice questions have been added yet.</div>':''}${mode==='notes'?notes(m):mode==='teach'?teach(m):quizSetup(m)}`}
function notes(m){let half=Math.ceil(m.sections.length/2);let filtered=m.sections.filter((s,i)=>part==='all'||(part==='1'?i<half:i>=half));return header(m)+`<div class="row partControls"><button data-part="all" class="${part==='all'?'primary':''}">Both parts</button><button data-part="1" class="${part==='1'?'primary':''}">Transcript · Part 1</button><button data-part="2" class="${part==='2'?'primary':''}">Transcript · Part 2</button><span class="quiet">${m.sections.length} content sections · source order</span></div>`+noteTools()+filtered.map(s=>sectionHTML(m,s,m.sections.indexOf(s))).join('')}
function teach(m,expanded=false){let s=m.sections[teachIndex];return `<div class="row teachcontrols">${expanded?versionControl(m):''}${expanded?'<button id="exitExpanded" aria-label="Close expanded view">✕ Close</button>':''}<button id="prevTeach" ${teachIndex===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous</button><select id="teachSelect" ${(m.id==='experiments-all'||m.id==='core-review-all')?'style="max-width:min(100%,560px);min-width:0"':''} aria-label="Teaching section">${m.sections.map((x,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===teachIndex?'selected':''}>${i+1}. ${esc(x.previewLabel||x.title)}${isCoreE(m,x)?' · Must know':''}</option>`).join('')}</select><button id="nextTeach" ${teachIndex===m.sections.length-1?'disabled':''}>Next →</button><button id="cover">${cover?'Reveal transcript':'Hide transcript'}</button><button id="speak">Read aloud</button><button id="stopSpeak">Stop audio</button><button class="tiny" data-font="-1">A−</button><button class="tiny" data-font="1">A+</button></div><div class="quiet previewhelper">Section ${teachIndex+1} / ${m.sections.length}. Arrow keys move between sections. Use the visual as a cue, then reveal the wording for support.</div><div class="split" style="margin-top:15px"><div class="card visual-pane ${isCoreE(m,s)?'core-e':''}">${s.media?researchVisual(s):`<img src="${s.image}" alt="${esc(s.title)}" data-zoom="1"><p class="caption">${s.reconstructed?'Reconstructed from supplied notes':'Original source page '+s.page} · click to enlarge</p>`}</div><div class="card transcript-pane">${priorityBadge(m,s)}${s.experimentTitle?`<p class="quiet">${esc(s.experimentTitle)} · ${esc(s.sourceTitle)}</p>`:s.sourceTitle?`<p class="quiet">${esc(s.sourceTitle)}</p>`:''}<h2>Section ${teachIndex+1}: ${esc(s.title)}</h2>${cover?'<div class="covered"><div><h3>Explain one small idea aloud.</h3><p>Use the visual. If you get stuck, reveal the transcript.</p><button class="primary" id="revealTeach">Reveal transcript</button></div></div>':`<div class="teaching" id="spoken"><ul>${sectionBullets(m,s).map(b=>`<li>${b}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div>`}<div class="sectionfoot"><label><input type="checkbox" data-read="${s.noteKey||m.id+':'+s.page}" ${state.read.includes(s.noteKey||m.id+':'+s.page)?'checked':''}> Mark read</label></div>${expanded?personalNotes(m,s):''}</div></div>${expanded?'':personalNotes(m,s)}`}

let coreReviewScroll=0,activeCoreReview='all';
function coreReviewCollections(){return M.filter(m=>!m.optional).map((m,i)=>({m,index:i,sections:m.sections.filter(s=>s.examPriorityE?.mustKnow)})).filter(group=>group.sections.length)}
function coreReviewModule(){return {id:'core-review-all',title:'Must know · core review',sections:coreReviewCollections().flatMap(({m,sections})=>sections.map(s=>({...s,sourceModule:m.id,sourceTitle:m.title,noteKey:m.id+':'+s.page,previewLabel:m.title+' · '+s.title})))}}
function coreReviewScreen(){const groups=coreReviewCollections(),count=groups.reduce((n,g)=>n+g.sections.length,0);return `<span class="priority-e">Must know · core review</span><h1>Must know · core review</h1><p class="quiet">${count} flagged sections · Collections 01–08 · Study guide + study-priority ranking</p><div class="row"><button class="primary" data-core-expand="all">Expand visual + transcript · all core review</button></div>${noteTools()}${groups.map(({m,index,sections})=>`<details class="guide core-review-group" open><summary>${String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')} · ${esc(m.title)} · ${sections.length} core sections</summary>${sections.map(s=>sectionHTML(m,s,m.sections.indexOf(s))).join('')}</details>`).join('')}`}
function richText(t){return esc(t).replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>')}

let activeExperiment=null,experimentScroll=0;
function experimentModule(){return {id:'experiments-all',title:'Experiments to know',sections:DATA.experiments.flatMap(e=>e.refs.map(([id,page])=>{const m=moduleBy(id),s=m.sections.find(s=>s.page===page);return {...s,noteKey:id+':'+page,sourceTitle:m.title,experimentId:e.id,experimentTitle:e.title,previewLabel:e.title+' · '+m.title+' · '+s.title}}))}}
function experimentsScreen(){const entries=DATA.experiments;return `<span class="tag">LECTURE EXPERIMENTS</span><h1>Experiments to know</h1><div class="row"><button class="primary" data-experiment-expand="all">Expand visual + transcript · all experiments</button><span class="quiet">${entries.length} experiments · ${entries.reduce((total,e)=>total+e.refs.length,0)} slides</span></div><div class="notice" style="margin:18px 0">Lectures 01–07 · Experiments, demonstrations, and case evidence · Articles and lab presentations excluded</div>${[...new Set(entries.map(e=>e.group))].map(group=>`<details class="guide essentials-group" open><summary>${esc(group)}</summary>${entries.filter(e=>e.group===group).map(e=>`<article class="essential-topic" id="experiment-${e.id}"><span class="tag">${esc(e.kind)}</span><h3>${esc(e.title)}</h3><div class="row" style="margin-bottom:16px"><button class="primary" data-experiment-expand="${e.id}">Expand visual + transcript</button></div><div class="experiment-pair"><div class="teaching"><ul>${[...new Set(e.refs.flatMap(([id,page])=>moduleBy(id).sections.find(s=>s.page===page).bullets))].map(b=>`<li>${b}</li>`).join('')}</ul><div class="row"><label class="quiet"><input type="checkbox" data-essential-done="experiment-${e.id}" ${(state.essentialsDone||[]).includes('experiment-'+e.id)?'checked':''}> I can explain this experiment</label></div></div><div class="experiment-slides">${e.refs.map(([id,page])=>{const m=moduleBy(id),slide=m.sections.find(s=>s.page===page);return `<figure><img loading="lazy" src="${slide.image}" alt="${esc(m.title)} · original page ${page}: ${esc(slide.title)}" data-zoom="1"><figcaption class="caption">${esc(m.title)} · original page ${page} · click to enlarge</figcaption></figure>`}).join('')}</div></div></article>`).join('')}</details>`).join('')}`}
function exitExpandedView(){if(view==='coreExpanded'){view='coreReview';render();window.scrollTo(0,coreReviewScroll);document.querySelector('[data-core-expand="'+activeCoreReview+'"]')?.focus({preventScroll:true})}else if(view==='experimentExpanded'){view='experiments';render();window.scrollTo(0,experimentScroll);document.querySelector('[data-experiment-expand="'+activeExperiment+'"]')?.focus({preventScroll:true})}else{mode='teach';render();document.querySelector('[data-mode="expanded"]')?.focus()}}

function essentialsScreen(){const topics=DATA.essentials||[];const groups=[...new Set(topics.map(t=>t.group))];return `<span class="tag">EXAM ESSENTIALS</span><h1>What to know by the end</h1><div class="row"><button class="primary" data-view="test">100-question practice exam</button><button data-view="missed">Missed & uncertain</button><button id="printEssentials">Print this guide</button></div><div class="notice" style="margin:18px 0">Chapters 1, 3, 4, and 11 · Five assigned articles · Short-term memory excluded</div>${groups.map(group=>`<details class="guide essentials-group" open><summary>${esc(group)}</summary>${topics.filter(t=>t.group===group).sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority).map(t=>`<article class="essential-topic"><h3>${esc(t.title)}</h3><div class="teaching"><ul>${t.bullets.map(b=>`<li>${richText(b.trim())}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div><div class="row"><label class="quiet"><input type="checkbox" data-essential-done="${t.id}" ${(state.essentialsDone||[]).includes(t.id)?'checked':''}> I can explain this and apply it</label><button class="tiny" data-essential-practice="${t.id}">Practice this topic</button><button class="tiny" data-source="${t.source}">Full explanation + visual</button></div></article>`).join('')}</details>`).join('')}`}
function startEssentialPractice(id){const topic=DATA.essentials.find(t=>t.id===id);if(!topic)return;const candidates=topic.questionIds.map(id=>Q.find(q=>q.id===id)).filter(Boolean);quiz={items:prepareQuizItems(shuffle(candidates)),index:0,answers:[],kind:'topic',finished:false};view='quiz';render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('#printEssentials'))window.print()});

function combined(){return `<span class="tag">MODULE 1 · EXAM 1 ARCHIVE</span><h1>Combined teaching notes</h1><p class="muted">Full explanations in source order within each collection. Open the collection you need; use search to locate an exact concept.</p>`+noteTools()+M.filter(m=>!window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)).map(m=>`<details class="guide" ${m.optional?'':'open'}><summary>${esc(m.title)} ${m.optional?'· extra scope':''}</summary>${header(m)}${m.sections.map((s,i)=>sectionHTML(m,s,i)).join('')}</details>`).join('')}
function quizSetup(m){return `<div class="card quiz"><h2>${m?'Practice this collection':'Combined practice test'}</h2><p>One question at a time. Every response gets a correct/incorrect indicator, an explanation, and a link to its notes. Answer positions are shuffled.</p>${m?`<div class="row"><button class="primary" data-start="module10">Quick set · up to 10</button><button data-start="moduleall">${Math.min(window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)?window.SECOND_HALF.lectureQuizSize:30,Q.filter(q=>q.module===m.id).length)}-question quiz</button></div>`:`<div class="scope">Chapters <strong>1, 3, 4, and 11</strong> and the five assigned articles. <strong>Short-term memory is excluded.</strong></div><div class="row"><button class="primary" data-start="exam100">100-question practice exam</button><button data-start="exam60">60-question practice</button><button data-start="exam65">65-question practice</button><button data-start="mixed10">10-question mixed warm-up</button></div>`}<p class="quiet">These are original practice items, not instructor questions. Immediate feedback is used even in the longer practice test.</p></div>`}
function shuffle(a){return a.map(v=>({v,r:Math.random()})).sort((a,b)=>a.r-b.r).map(x=>x.v)}
// Choice indices stay tied to the source answer, regardless of displayed A–D order.
function shuffleChoiceOrder(length){const order=Array.from({length},(_,i)=>i);for(let i=order.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[order[i],order[j]]=[order[j],order[i]]}return order}
function validateAnswerKey(items){let valid=true,previous=-1;for(const q of items){const position=q.order.indexOf(q.correct);if(position<0||q.order.length!==q.options.length||new Set(q.order).size!==q.options.length||q.order.some(i=>!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>=q.options.length)||position===previous)valid=false;previous=position}return valid}
function prepareQuizItems(questions){const sources=questions.map(q=>{if(q.options.length!==4||!Number.isInteger(q.correct)||q.correct<0||q.correct>=q.options.length)throw Error('Invalid quiz choices');return {...q,options:q.options.map(text=>text.replace(/^(All|None) of the above$/i,(_,word)=>word+' of the other options')),why:q.why.replace(/all of the above/gi,'all of the other options').replace(/none of the above/gi,'none of the other options')}});let candidate=sources.map(q=>({...q,order:shuffleChoiceOrder(q.options.length)}));while(!validateAnswerKey(candidate)){// Reject the key and rebuild. Local rejection avoids exponential retries on long exams.
 candidate=[];for(const q of sources){let order;do{order=shuffleChoiceOrder(q.options.length)}while(candidate.length&&order.indexOf(q.correct)===candidate[candidate.length-1].order.indexOf(candidate[candidate.length-1].correct));candidate.push({...q,order})}}return candidate}
function weightedOrder(items){return items.map(q=>({q,key:-Math.log(Math.max(Number.MIN_VALUE,Math.random()))/(q.priority||1)})).sort((a,b)=>a.key-b.key).map(x=>x.q)}
function startQuiz(kind){let pool=[];if(kind.startsWith('module'))pool=shuffle(Q.filter(q=>q.module===selected)).slice(0,kind==='module10'?10:30);else if(kind==='missed')pool=shuffle(Q.filter(q=>state.missed.includes(q.id)));else if(kind==='mixed10')pool=shuffle(Q.filter(q=>!window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(q.module))).slice(0,10);else{let quotas=kind==='exam100'?DATA.examQuotas100:kind==='exam65'?[9,15,18,15,8]:[8,14,17,14,7];let groups=[[3],[5,2],[7,4],[8,1],[0]];groups.forEach((ids,i)=>{let candidates=Q.filter(q=>ids.includes(q.module)&&(i!==4||(q.page>=12&&q.page<=16)));if(candidates.length<quotas[i])throw Error('Not enough questions for group '+i);let ordered=kind==='exam100'?weightedOrder(candidates):shuffle(candidates);if(kind==='exam100'&&i===4){let required=[12,13,14,15,16].map(p=>ordered.find(q=>q.page===p));let used=new Set(required.map(q=>q.id));ordered=[...required,...ordered.filter(q=>!used.has(q.id))]}pool.push(...ordered.slice(0,quotas[i]))});pool=shuffle(pool)}if(!pool.length)return;quiz={items:prepareQuizItems(pool),index:0,answers:[],kind,finished:false};view='quiz';render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function quizScreen(){if(!quiz)return quizSetup();if(quiz.finished)return results();let q=quiz.items[quiz.index],a=quiz.answers[quiz.index],done=quiz.answers.filter(Boolean).length;let correct=quiz.answers.filter((x,i)=>x&&x.choice===quiz.items[i].correct).length;return `<div class="quiz"><div class="row"><span class="tag">${quiz.kind.startsWith('exam')?'MIXED PRACTICE TEST':'PRACTICE SET'}</span><span class="quiet">${esc(moduleBy(q.module).title)}</span></div><div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px"><strong>Question ${quiz.index+1} of ${quiz.items.length}</strong><span class="quiet">${correct} correct · ${done} answered</span></div><div class="progress"><div style="width:${done/quiz.items.length*100}%"></div></div><div class="card"><div class="quizstem">${esc(q.stem)}</div><div class="options">${q.order.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option ${a?(v===q.correct?'correct':a.choice===v?'wrong':''):''}" data-answer="${v}" ${a?'disabled':''}><span class="letter">${'ABCD'[i]}</span><span>${esc(q.options[v])}${a&&v===q.correct?' <strong>✓ Correct answer</strong>':a&&v===a.choice?' <strong>✕ Your answer</strong>':''}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>${a?`<div class="feedback ${a.choice===q.correct?'':'incorrect'}" role="status"><strong>${a.choice===q.correct?'✓ Correct':a.choice===null?'◉ Answer revealed · not scored correct':'✕ Incorrect · review this idea'}</strong><p>${esc(q.why)}</p><button class="tiny" data-source="${q.module}:${q.page}">Open matching explanation + visual</button><button class="tiny" id="uncertain">${state.missed.includes(q.id)?'Queued for another try':'Mark uncertain · revisit'}</button></div>`:''}<div class="quizfooter"><button id="prevQ" ${quiz.index===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous</button>${!a?'<button id="revealAnswer">Reveal & learn</button><button id="skipQ">Skip for now</button>':''}<button class="primary" id="nextQ" ${!a?'disabled':''}>${quiz.index===quiz.items.length-1?'See results':'Next question →'}</button></div></div><div class="quiet">A–D or 1–4 selects an answer. Feedback stays visible until you continue. An answer revealed without a choice is not counted as correct.</div></div>`}
function answer(choice){if(!quiz||quiz.finished||quiz.answers[quiz.index])return;const q=quiz.items[quiz.index];quiz.answers[quiz.index]={choice};state.attempts.push({id:q.id,correct:choice===q.correct});if(choice===q.correct)state.missed=state.missed.filter(id=>id!==q.id);else if(!state.missed.includes(q.id))state.missed.push(q.id);save();render()}
function results(){let good=quiz.answers.filter((a,i)=>a?.choice===quiz.items[i].correct).length,answered=quiz.answers.filter(Boolean).length;return `<div class="quiz"><div class="hero"><span class="tag">PRACTICE RESULTS</span><h1>${good} / ${quiz.items.length} correct</h1><p>${answered} answered · ${quiz.items.length-answered} unanswered. Revealed answers are included in answered, but not counted correct.</p><div class="row"><button class="primary" data-start="missed" ${state.missed.length?'':'disabled'}>Retry missed & uncertain</button><button data-view="test">Choose another set</button></div></div>${quiz.items.map((q,i)=>{let a=quiz.answers[i];return `<details class="guide"><summary>${a?.choice===q.correct?'✓':a?'✕':'○'} ${i+1}. ${esc(q.stem)}</summary><p><strong>Correct:</strong> ${esc(q.options[q.correct])}</p><p>${esc(q.why)}</p><button class="tiny" data-source="${q.module}:${q.page}">Review source explanation</button></details>`}).join('')}</div>`}
function lectureQuizzes(){return `<h1>Lecture quizzes</h1><div class="grid">${M.filter(m=>!window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)).map(m=>`<div class="card"><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><p>${Math.min(window.SECOND_HALF.modules.includes(m.id)?window.SECOND_HALF.lectureQuizSize:30,Q.filter(q=>q.module===m.id).length)} questions</p><button class="primary" data-lecture-quiz="${m.id}">Start quiz</button><button data-module="${m.id}">Teaching notes</button></div>`).join('')}</div>`}
function missed(){let items=Q.filter(q=>state.missed.includes(q.id));return `<h1>Missed & uncertain</h1><p class="muted">${items.length} questions queued. Correct answers can be queued too if you recognized an option but still want another attempt.</p><button class="primary" data-start="missed" ${items.length?'':'disabled'}>Retry this queue</button>${items.length?items.map(q=>`<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><span class="tag">${esc(moduleBy(q.module).title)}</span><h3>${esc(q.stem)}</h3><button class="tiny" data-source="${q.module}:${q.page}">Read the matching notes</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty" style="margin-top:20px">Your queue is empty. Start a practice set to find the sections worth another pass.</div>'}`}

Required article topics are musical training and selective listening, media multitasking, English/Mandarin time, children's pseudohomophones, and emergency wayfinding.</p>${M.map(m=>`<div class="card" style="margin:12px 0"><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><p class="quiet">${esc(m.file)} · ${m.original.length} source pages · ${m.sections.length} teaching sections</p><button data-module="${m.id}">Open collection</button><button class="tiny" data-original="${m.id}">View original pages</button></div>`).join('')}<h2>Source inconsistencies handled</h2><ul><li><p>The labs notes contain a Simon-task example inconsistent with their stated response keys. The example here uses green/right consistently with the stated m/right mapping.</p></li><li><p>The labs whole-report description calls four of twelve a quarter. The sensory-memory PDF reports 4.5 of twelve, or 37.5%; the notes here use that explicit result. Classifier accuracy, correlational training results, and statistical mediation are not treated as universal performance or proof of causation.</p></li></ul><h2>Your browser data</h2><p>Personal notes, read checkmarks, quiz attempts, and retry items are stored locally.
